source.author: cic
source.text: et si habet Asia suspicionem luxuriae quandam, non Asiam numquam vidisse sed in Asia continenter vixisse laudandum est.
source.text_original: et si habet Asia suspicionem luxuriae quandam, non Asiam numquam vidisse sed in Asia continenter vixisse laudandum est.
source.text_english: and if Asia has a certain reputation for luxury, it is praiseworthy not never to have seen Asia, but to have lived continuously in Asia.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: non Hierosolymis fuisse, sed Hierosolymis bene uixisse laudandum est.
reuse.text_original: non Hierosolymis fuisse, sed Hierosolymis bene uixisse laudandum est.
reuse.text_english: It is worthy of praise not to have been in Jerusalem, but to have lived well in Jerusalem.
